company.name: Lyvely
company.shortDescription: Lyvely is a SocialFi and creator monetization platform that enables creators and freelancers to build communities, sell content & services.
company.description: Lyvely is a Dubai-based creator economy platform designed to help creators, coaches, freelancers, and entrepreneurs monetize their digital presence. The platform offers an all-in-one ecosystem where users can create paid memberships, sell digital content, host live streams, conduct video consultations, receive tips, and build private or public communities. Unlike traditional social media platforms that rely heavily on advertising, Lyvely focuses on direct creator monetization and revenue-sharing models. The company also integrates Web3 and blockchain capabilities through its native LVLY token, enabling token-based rewards, tipping, gated content access, and social commerce experiences. Lyvely positions itself as a “social super app” for creators by combining communication tools, e-commerce, community engagement, and creator business management in one platform.
